$comment: WF1 "conversion roadmap" (2026-09-10). Spec 122 §1.10 archetype census, DECLARED
DATA per the R-T precedent (§10.3) — never name-prefix inference (the defect Ask A6
retires). Rows cover every one of the 55 currently-unconverted files, PLUS the ONE
`pending` file (enrich-parcels.js — a real descriptor exists, commit 7b, but the file
is not yet in converted.json's own `converted[]` array). Rows for already-converted
files were originally deliberately ABSENT — a converted step's own
`descriptor.identity.archetype` is provenance rule 1 (authoritative), so re-declaring
it here would be a second, driftable copy of the same fact.
REVISED 2026-09-15 (Spec 124 §5 R-AO retention): deletion at cutover made fast
invariant #25 ARCHETYPE-PARITY UNREACHABLE for the very case R-AO exists for — with
no row left, `censusArchetype` is null for every converted slug and a valid-but-wrong
archetype passes silently (proved by swapping `load_ravines` to ASSERT). Cutover now
RETAINS the row with `status: "converted"` + `converted_at`. The retained `archetype`
is the census's OWN pre-cutover value, not a copy of the descriptor — that is what
makes #25 a comparison of two independently-authored facts rather than of a value
with itself. MEASURED LIMIT, recorded not papered over: only FOUR of the twelve
already-converted slugs have a pre-cutover archetype anywhere in this file's git
history (enrich_parcels ENRICHER @9f2afcb6, assert_global_coverage ASSERT @272d8ae0,
assert_data_bounds ASSERT @58c35378, assert_engine_health RECORDER @331f97ad). This
census was authored 2026-09-10 as "the currently-unconverted files", so the other
eight were ALREADY converted and never had a row; inventing one would fabricate the
exact second copy the paragraph above forbids. Those eight carry no row and #25's
census arm reads not-applicable for them. Every cutover from batch 2 on retains its own.
archetype is one of the 8 canonical Spec 122 §1.10 values, or the literal string
"UNDECLARED" — a real, explicit row, never a silently-absent one. The `sources`
rows carrying a real archetype are the C4 remainder plus C5's 13 conversions.
CORRECTED 2026-09-15 (Spec 124 §5 R-AP, batch-2 Phase 0.8): `reconcile` no longer
has an `entries[]` row at all. It was the 14th C5 slug, declared UNDECLARED with
its own reason; it is now an `exemptions[]` row with `reason: "runner_owned"` —
the THIRD exemption class — because the concern it implements is owned by THE
RUNNER (Spec 122 §4 / §7.3 concern row 4 / §7.4 A3), so there is no per-step
descriptor, no `identity.archetype` to pick, and no conversion to do. C5 is
therefore **13** conversions, not 14. The remaining 36 rows (permits/coa/deep_scrapes/
entities+wsib, plus 2 orphan scripts with no manifest.chains membership at all —
`reclassify_all`/`observe_chain`, a genuine finding this WF1 measured and is not
silently folding into any of the plan's named buckets) are UNDECLARED per Ask A3:
the census stops at the 27 `sources` steps; seeding the other 36 is ARCH-CENSUS's
own future WF, run once before C6 opens (Ask A3's own ruling).
Cross-check the generator performs: every `slug`/`file` pair here must resolve to a
real `manifest.scripts` entry with that exact `file` value (throws otherwise); no
duplicate slugs; every archetype is one of the 9 legal values (schema-enforced).
